ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلْحَآقَّةُ ۝١
ayahs.translation: The Inevitable Reality -
ayahs.translationClear: The Reality.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ ۝٢
ayahs.translation: What is the Inevitable Reality?
ayahs.translationClear: What is the Reality?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ ۝٣
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
ayahs.translationClear: What will make you understand what the Reality is?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ ۝٤
ayahs.translation: Thamūd and ʿAad denied the Striking Calamity [i.e., the Resurrection].
ayahs.translationClear: Thamood and Aad denied the Catastrophe.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ ۝٥
ayahs.translation: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].
ayahs.translationClear: As for Thamood, they were annihilated by the Overwhelming.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَمَّا عَادٌ فَاُهْلِكُوْا بِرِيْحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming,[1737] violent wind
ayahs.translationClear: And as for Aad; they were annihilated by a furious, roaring wind.

ayahs.textUthmani: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَّثَمٰنِيَةَ اَيَّامٍۙ حُسُوْمًاۙ فَتَرَي الْقَوْمَ فِيْهَا صَرْعٰيۙ كَاَنَّهُمْ اَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Which He [i.e., Allāh] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
ayahs.transliteration: Sakhkharahaa 'alayhim sab'a layaalin wathamaaniyata ayyaamin husooman fataral-qawma feehaa sar'aa ka'annahum a'jaazu nakhlin khaawiyah
ayahs.translationClear: He unleashed it upon them for seven nights and eight days, in succession. You could see the people tossed around, as though they were stumps of hollow palm-trees.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍ ۝٨
ayahs.translation: Then do you see of them any remains?
ayahs.translationClear: Can you see any remnant of them?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَجَا࢜ءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَنْ قَبْلَهٗ وَالْمُو͏ٔ͏ْتَفِكٰتُ بِالْخَاطِي͏ٔ͏َةِ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities[1738] with sin.
ayahs.transliteration: Wajaa'a fir'awnu waman qablahoo wal-mu'tafikaatu bil-khaati'ah

footnotes.1738: Those to which Lot was sent (see 11:82-83) or generally, all cities which were destroyed due to their denial of a messenger from Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: Then Pharaoh came, and those before him, and the Overturned Cities steeped in sin.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: فَعَصَوْا رَسُوْلَ رَبِّهِمْ فَاَخَذَهُمْ اَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
ayahs.translation: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'asaw rasoola rabbihim fa'akhadhahum akhdhatar raabiyah
ayahs.translationClear: But they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an overpowering grip.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا الْمَا࢜ءُ حَمَلْنٰكُمْ فِي الْجَارِيَةِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you [i.e., your ancestors] in the sailing ship[1739]
ayahs.translationClear: When the waters overflowed, We carried you in the cruising ship.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَّتَعِيَهَا͏ٓ اُذُنٌ وَّاعِيَةٌ

words.translation: and would be conscious of it

ayahs.translation: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
ayahs.transliteration: Linaj'alahaa lakum tadhkiratan wata'iyahaa udhunun waa'iyah
ayahs.translationClear: To make it a lesson for you—so that retaining ears may retain it.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّوْرِ نَفْخَةٌ وَّاحِدَةٌ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
ayahs.translationClear: Then, when the Trumpet is sounded a single time.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّحُمِلَتِ الْاَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَّاحِدَةً ۙ
ayahs.translation: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -
ayahs.translationClear: And the earth and the mountains are lifted up, and crushed, with a single crush.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ ۝١٥
ayahs.translation: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,
ayahs.translationClear: On that Day, the Event will come to pass.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ ۝١٦
ayahs.translation: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.[1740]
ayahs.translationClear: And the heaven will crack; so on that Day it will be frail.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا‌ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّالْمَلَكُ عَلٰٓي اَرْجَا࢜ىِٕهَاؕ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ ثَمٰنِيَةٌ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-malaku 'alaa arjaa'ihaa wayahmilu 'arsha rabbika fawqahum yawma'idhin thamaaniyah
ayahs.translationClear: And the angels will be ranged around its borders, while eight will be carrying the Throne of your Lord above them that Day.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَىِٕذٍ تُعْرَضُوْنَ لَا تَخْفٰي مِنْكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
ayahs.translation: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.[1741]
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma'idhin tu'radoona laa takhfaa minkum khaafiyah

footnotes.1741: i.e., any person or any secret you might attempt to conceal.

ayahs.translationClear: On that Day you will be exposed, and no secret of yours will remain hidden.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَمَّا مَنْ اُوْتِيَ كِتٰبَهٗ بِيَمِيْنِهٖۙ فَيَقُوْلُ هَا࢜و͏ٔ͏ُمُ اقْرَءُوْا كِتٰبِيَهْ ۚ
ayahs.translation: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenihee fayaqoolu haa'umuqra'oo kitaabiyah
ayahs.translationClear: As for him who is given his book in his right hand, he will say, “Here, take my book and read it.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَـٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ ۝٢٠
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
ayahs.translationClear: I knew I would be held accountable.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ ۝٢١
ayahs.translation: So he will be in a pleasant life -
ayahs.translationClear: So he will be in pleasant living.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ ۝٢٢
ayahs.translation: In an elevated garden,
ayahs.translationClear: In a lofty Garden.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ ۝٢٣
ayahs.translation: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
ayahs.translationClear: Its pickings are within reach.

ayahs.textUthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: كُلُوْا وَاشْرَبُوْا هَنِيْ࢜ـٔ͏ًاۢ بِمَا͏ٓ اَسْلَفْتُمْ فِي الْاَيَّامِ الْخَالِيَةِ
ayahs.translation: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth[1742] in the days past."
ayahs.transliteration: Kuloo washraboo hanee'am bimaa aslaftum fil-ayyaamil-khaaliyah

footnotes.1742: Literally, "advanced" in anticipation of reward in the Hereafter.

ayahs.translationClear: “Eat and drink merrily for what you did in the days gone by.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَمَّا مَنْ اُوْتِيَ كِتٰبَهٗ بِشِمَالِهٖ࣢ۙ فَيَقُوْلُ يٰلَيْتَنِيْ لَمْ اُوْتَ كِتٰبِيَهْ ۚ
ayahs.translation: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo bishimaalihee fayaqoolu yaalaytanee lam oota kitaabiyah
ayahs.translationClear: But as for him who is given his book in his left hand, he will say, “I wish I was never given my book.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ ۝٢٦
ayahs.translation: And had not known what is my account.
ayahs.translationClear: And never knew what my account was.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ ۝٢٧
ayahs.translation: I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.[1743]

footnotes.1743: i.e., ending life rather than being the gateway to eternal life.

ayahs.translationClear: If only it was the end.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ‌ۜ ۝٢٨
ayahs.translation: My wealth has not availed me.
ayahs.translationClear: My money cannot avail me.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَـٰنِيَهْ ۝٢٩
ayahs.translation: Gone from me is my authority."[1744]

footnotes.1744: i.e., I have no valid excuse to stand on.

ayahs.translationClear: My power has vanished from me.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ ۝٣٠
ayahs.translation: [Allāh will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
ayahs.translationClear: “Take him and shackle him.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ ۝٣١
ayahs.translation: Then into Hellfire drive him.
ayahs.translationClear: Then scorch him in the Blaze.

ayahs.textUthmani: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: ثُمَّ فِيْ سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُوْنَ ذِرَاعًا فَاسْلُكُوْهُ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma fee silsilatin dhar'uhaa sab'oona dhiraa'an faslukooh
ayahs.translationClear: Then in a chain whose length is seventy cubits tie him up.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّهٗ كَانَ لَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُ بِاللّٰهِ الْعَظِيْمِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allāh, the Most Great,
ayahs.translationClear: For he would not believe in Allah the Great.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ ۝٣٤
ayahs.translation: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
ayahs.translationClear: Nor would he advocate the feeding of the destitute.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَـٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌ ۝٣٥
ayahs.translation: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
ayahs.translationClear: So he has no friend here today.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ ۝٣٦
ayahs.translation: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
ayahs.translationClear: And no food except scum.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَـٰطِـُٔونَ ۝٣٧
ayahs.translation: None will eat it except the sinners.
ayahs.translationClear: Which only the sinners eat.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ ۝٣٨
ayahs.translation: So I swear by what you see
ayahs.translationClear: Indeed, I swear by what you see.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ ۝٣٩
ayahs.translation: And what you do not see
ayahs.translationClear: And by what you do not see.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ ۝٤٠
ayahs.translation: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the word of a noble Messenger.
ayahs.translationClear: It is the speech of a noble messenger.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ‌ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍؕ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa huwa biqawli shaa'irin qaleelam maa tu'minoon
ayahs.translationClear: And it is not the speech of a poet—little do you believe.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ‌ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍؕ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُوْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaa biqawli kaahinin qaleelam maa tadhakkaroon
ayahs.translationClear: Nor is it the speech of a soothsayer—little do you take heed.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝٤٣
ayahs.translation: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.translationClear: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ ۝٤٤
ayahs.translation: And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
ayahs.translationClear: Had he falsely attributed some statements to Us.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ ۝٤٥
ayahs.translation: We would have seized him by the right hand;[1745]

footnotes.1745: Another interpretation is "by [Our] right hand," i.e., Allāh would have exacted revenge with might and power.

ayahs.translationClear: We would have seized him by the right arm.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ ۝٤٦
ayahs.translation: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.[1746]
ayahs.translationClear: Then slashed his lifeline.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ ۝٤٧
ayahs.textIndopak: فَمَا مِنْكُمْ مِّنْ اَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حٰجِزِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
ayahs.translationClear: And none of you could have restrained Us from him.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ ۝٤٨
ayahs.translation: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.
ayahs.translationClear: Surely, it is a message for the righteous.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ ۝٤٩
ayahs.translation: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
ayahs.translationClear: And We know that some of you will reject it.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ ۝٥٠
ayahs.translation: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
ayahs.translationClear: And it is surely a source of grief for the unbelievers.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ ۝٥١
ayahs.translation: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
ayahs.translationClear: Yet it is the absolute truth.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۝٥٢
ayahs.translation: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
ayahs.translationClear: So glorify the name of your Lord, the Magnificent.
